items.prompt: At a day with value 80, earlier values are [60,100], and a later value will be 150. Which peak is allowed for TODAY's drawdown?

options.text: 150, because it is the largest value anywhere in the full path.
options.why: A future peak cannot serve as the earlier denominator for today's decline.

options.text: 100, the largest value observed up to today.
options.why: The prefix peak respects the peak-before-trough ordering.
Later historical highs must update the prefix peak.

options.text: 80, the average of the earlier values.
options.why: Drawdown uses a historical maximum, not the historical average.

items.explanation: The prefix peak respects the peak-before-trough ordering.
